title: Retrieval, text/image-to-image search
reading: A single full-width figure illustrates visual search as an application of learned embeddings: image crops or product photos are encoded by a CNN into a shared embedding space where nearest neighbours give retrieval results. No body text beyond the figure captions.

visuals.description: Pipeline: (a) Query 1 is a kitchen scene with a blue box around a pendant lamp, cropped; (a) Query 2 is a product photo of an Eames lounge chair. Both feed into a box labelled 'Convolutional Neural Network' with 'Learned Parameters θ'. (b) Outputs are projected into a 256D embedding, shown as a dense cloud of thumbnails with two marked points. Arrows lead to (c) Results 1: visually similar pendant lamp products, and (c) Results 2: interior photos with the chair boxed in green in-situ.
visuals.assertion: A CNN trained to embed crops and products into a common 256D space supports both scene-crop-to-product and product-to-scene retrieval via nearest neighbours in that space.

concepts.name: Image embedding space
concepts.why_it_matters: Retrieval reduces to nearest-neighbour search once images map to a common vector space.

concepts.name: Convolutional Neural Network
concepts.why_it_matters: Serves as the encoder producing the embedding.

concepts.name: Cross-domain retrieval (scene ↔ product)
concepts.why_it_matters: Shows the same embedding serves two directions of search.
